title: Scope boundaries must be enforced before ranking
summary: Candidate scope is an authority constraint, not a cosmetic ranking feature.
statement: When records carry project or transfer boundaries, those boundaries must be enforced before ranking or fusion so unauthorized candidates never influence the result set.
why_it_is_stable: The need to prevent unauthorized candidates from affecting ranking survives backend changes because it is rooted in authority boundaries rather than any single retrieval engine.
non_scope: global search explicitly requested by the caller
applicability_conditions: Records can belong to distinct projects or transfer classes
The retrieval system supports candidate pruning or metadata filtering
non_applicability_conditions: All candidate pools are intentionally global and unbounded
known_breakers: Backend adapters that cannot reject out-of-scope candidates early
